Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) per dose

Poison. Smear a whole vial on a Light Melee Weapon as an Action; it lasts 1 minute (20 Rounds). While coated, the weapon deals no normal damage; instead, a flesh-and-blood target it hits must beat DV17 Resist Torture/Drugs or take 3d6 straight to HP, ignoring and not ablating SP. On that damage, 5s count as 6s toward Critical Injuries, which it can cause (Dismemberments deal their Bonus Damage without the dismemberment). They can be Head Critical Injuries if the attack was a Head Aimed Shot. Corgo's optional rule: a victim who resists a poison takes half damage (roll, then halve) instead of none.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Poisons).
